page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top left and top centre, page number top right, a "Cap. I." heading in the right margin beside the top lines; handwritten marginal notes in the right margin (not transcribed as printed text, only noted); a centred section heading "SECTIO QVINTA" mid-page; body text below; catchword "qui-" at lower right.

main_text.p: prie informet. Sed jam ἄλλᾳ βοηθείᾳ; verbum non amplius addimus de Privatione. & sicui haec omnia nondum satisfaciunt (animis enim pertinaciter in aliqua secta obfirmatis nulla rationum momenta satisfacere queant) ille Materiam primam & Formam substantialem asserat prius à nostris objectionibus, & postea super Privatione pedem nobiscum conferat. namq; illis sublatis hanc ne ipsi quidem posuerint Peripatetici.
main_text.head: SECTIO QVINTA.
main_text.p: Transitur ad examinandam Aristotelis sententiam de Causis. Principia sua Aristoteles & Aristotelici etiam Elementa vocant. A Causis potius quam à Principiis incipere debuerat Aristoteles. II. Aristotelis scopus in tractatione de Principiis ac Causis. III. In quibus culpemus tractationem Aristotelis de Causis, in secundo Physicorum institutam. IV. Vanitas istius axiomatis, Efficiens, Formam & Finem, idem esse in naturalibus. V. Difficultas, quomodo Agentia naturalia, cognitionis expertia, agant propter finem: & Aristotelis ad eam responsio. VI. Cavillatoria vanitas istius responsi; aliag in eo absurda. VII. Quod Aristoteles statuit, Naturam agere propter finem; in eo nihil novi dixit, quum recepta Veterum haec fuerit sententia. VIII. Vera Veterum assertio, Agentia naturalia agere ex congenitâ necessitate: explicatur. IX. Aristotelis inconstantia: sententiam modo dictam maligne detorquet. X. Incusatur Aristoteles, quod nihil de natura ac modo operandi Finalis Causae tradiderit. Absurda plerorumq; Aristotelicorum opinio, Finem agere secundum esse regale. XI. Absurditas Peripateticorum, negantium Causalitatem Finis consistere in motu, quo ciet appetitum. Finis non est peculiare Causae genus, sed Efficientis quaedam species. XII. Aliy defectus in hac tractatione de Fine. Epilogus totius disqui-
main_text.note: quam, cur, quando, quomodo, quo fine, quo facto.
Ipse, tantundem, Indifferenter, promiscuum, coincidens, codem sensu, contendere, distinguere, pro aequo, quomodo, aequali.

page.notes: The right-margin handwritten annotations are in manuscript and are only summarised as notes; their readings are uncertain. The final word of the page is printed as "disqui-" with the catchword "qui-" below. Several Greek words in the first paragraph are uncertain ([?] not marked due to low legibility). Show-through and stains are not transcribed.
